tasks.label: CampuGO: 1. Démarrer l’émulateur Android
tasks.command: export DOTNET_ROOT="$HOME/.dotnet" JAVA_HOME="$HOME/.local/share/jdk17" ANDROID_HOME="$HOME/Android/Sdk" ANDROID_SDK_ROOT="$HOME/Android/Sdk" PATH="$HOME/.dotnet:$HOME/.local/share/jdk17/bin:$HOME/Android/Sdk/emulator:$HOME/Android/Sdk/platform-tools:$HOME/Android/Sdk/cmdline-tools/latest/bin:$PATH" && emulator -avd CampuGO_API_36 -gpu host -no-snapshot-save

tasks.label: CampuGO: 2. Vérifier l’émulateur (adb devices)
tasks.command: export DOTNET_ROOT="$HOME/.dotnet" JAVA_HOME="$HOME/.local/share/jdk17" ANDROID_HOME="$HOME/Android/Sdk" ANDROID_SDK_ROOT="$HOME/Android/Sdk" PATH="$HOME/.dotnet:$HOME/.local/share/jdk17/bin:$HOME/Android/Sdk/emulator:$HOME/Android/Sdk/platform-tools:$HOME/Android/Sdk/cmdline-tools/latest/bin:$PATH" && adb devices

tasks.label: CampuGO: Relier l’API au téléphone (adb reverse)
tasks.command: export DOTNET_ROOT="$HOME/.dotnet" JAVA_HOME="$HOME/.local/share/jdk17" ANDROID_HOME="$HOME/Android/Sdk" ANDROID_SDK_ROOT="$HOME/Android/Sdk" PATH="$HOME/.dotnet:$HOME/.local/share/jdk17/bin:$HOME/Android/Sdk/emulator:$HOME/Android/Sdk/platform-tools:$HOME/Android/Sdk/cmdline-tools/latest/bin:$PATH" && adb reverse tcp:7080 tcp:7080

tasks.label: CampuGO: 3. Lancer sur l’émulateur (Debug)
tasks.command: export DOTNET_ROOT="$HOME/.dotnet" JAVA_HOME="$HOME/.local/share/jdk17" ANDROID_HOME="$HOME/Android/Sdk" ANDROID_SDK_ROOT="$HOME/Android/Sdk" PATH="$HOME/.dotnet:$HOME/.local/share/jdk17/bin:$HOME/Android/Sdk/emulator:$HOME/Android/Sdk/platform-tools:$HOME/Android/Sdk/cmdline-tools/latest/bin:$PATH" && dotnet build CampuGO.csproj -f net10.0-android -t:Run

tasks.label: CampuGO: Compiler et lancer sur l’émulateur (APK Release)
tasks.command: export DOTNET_ROOT="$HOME/.dotnet" JAVA_HOME="$HOME/.local/share/jdk17" ANDROID_HOME="$HOME/Android/Sdk" ANDROID_SDK_ROOT="$HOME/Android/Sdk" PATH="$HOME/.dotnet:$HOME/.local/share/jdk17/bin:$HOME/Android/Sdk/emulator:$HOME/Android/Sdk/platform-tools:$HOME/Android/Sdk/cmdline-tools/latest/bin:$PATH" && dotnet build CampuGO.csproj -c Release -f net10.0-android && adb wait-for-device && adb install -r bin/Release/net10.0-android/com.campugo.app-Signed.apk && adb shell monkey -p com.campugo.app 1
